entries.text: Are you ready to face Hassel of the Elite Four?
entries.label: champ_0250_system_01

entries.text: I was, of course, absolutely certain you would\nmake it to me eventually.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_01

entries.text: Young sprouts truly do grow with astounding\nspeed, yes...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_02

entries.text: But I never for a moment imagined we would be\nfacing each other so soon![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_03

entries.text: Now, a teacher’s duty is to guide students and\naid their growth.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_04

entries.text: But I think I shall forget about my role as a\nteacher for a moment...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_05

entries.text: and wield all my might for the sole purpose of\ndefeating you![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_06

entries.text: I am Hassel, the dragon guarding the final\nfortress of the Elite Test.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_07

entries.text: Prepare to learn firsthand how the fiery breath\nof ferocious battle feels![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_17

entries.text: Y-you really did it...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_01

entries.text: Wo...WONDERBUL![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_08

entries.text: I’b...I’b just so proud ob you...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_09

entries.text: BWUUUH huh huh hoi hoi![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_10

entries.text: Awww, don’t cry, Grandpa Hassel! There, there—\nwanna hug?[VAR 0x0114(0014)]
entries.label: champ_0250_steel_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Sorry ’bout all this, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
The
old
man
can
get
like
that
sometimes.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_02

entries.text: So whad ib I do?! I’b jusd—jusd so oberwhelmed![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_11

entries.text: Guess I’ve got to do the talking...\c\nAnyway, your result for the Elite Test of the\nChampion Assessment is...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_03

entries.text: a pass! No doubt about it![VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_04

entries.text: Yeeeaaah! You’re tougher than steel![VAR 0x0114(0014)]
entries.label: champ_0250_steel_03

entries.text: Y-you did so BEAUDIFULLY![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_12

entries.text: Congratulations![VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_05

entries.text: I’d say you’re good to go, but...there’s actually\njust a wee bit more to the Champion Assessment.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_06

entries.text: This’ll be your final trial.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_07

entries.text: See the door back there?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_08

entries.text: Our fearless commander—the final opponent\nyou’ll face for your test—is waiting beyond it.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_09

entries.text: Her skills are so amazing, she was able to\nstrong-arm all of us into joining the Elite Four.\c\nYou won’t find a mightier Champion.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_10

entries.text: Though I think you’ll do fine, kiddo! You beat\nme, after all![VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_11

entries.text: I’ll patch up your team—on the house—so don’t\nlose, you hear?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_14

entries.text: I really love your Pokémon, miss![VAR 0x0114(0014)]
entries.label: champ_0250_steel_04a

entries.text: I really love your Pokémon, mister![VAR 0x0114(0014)]
entries.label: champ_0250_steel_04b

entries.text: So I’ll cheer for you as hard as I can![VAR 0x0114(0014)]
entries.label: champ_0250_steel_05

entries.text: Well, uh, good lu—[VAR 0x0114(0015)]
entries.label: champ_0250_fly_03

entries.text: Even a baby dragon can breathe fire![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_13

entries.text: Whoa! Guess you got over your sobs, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_12

entries.text: You can do this. We all know you can.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_14

entries.text:

entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_15

entries.text:

Show
us
the
fight
of
the century![VAR 0x0114(0013)]
entries.label: champ_0250_ground_13

entries.text: Good luck on your final test![VAR 0x0114(0014)]
entries.label: champ_0250_steel_06

entries.text: Ahem... Good luck.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]
entries.label: champ_0250_fly_04

entries.text:
Your final opponent is terribly strong—but then,
so are you!\c
Banish your fear! With a calm mind, you will
surely see the path to triumph![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: champ_0250_dragon_16
